text: In a suburb of Dakar on the Atlantic coast, a gleaming tower nears its opening while the men who built it [go months without pay|wrong|exploitation for profit]. One night they set out [across the sea|images|water and drowning] for Spain, among them Souleiman, lover of Ada, who is promised to the wealthy Omar. On her wedding day Omar's bed bursts into flame, a young detective falls strangely ill, and the lost men [return at night inside the bodies of the living|threat|being taken over], [demanding their wages|wants|revenge for a wrong] and [graves where they can rest|wants|release and unfinished business].
